headline: Property damage from natural disasters could increase insurance claims
summary: The Indonesian general insurance association AAUI says extensive damage to homes and facilities from natural disasters is increasing claims in insurance lines.
why: Property insurers pay out claims after disasters, which raises loss ratios and can affect earnings and pricing. Catastrophe losses are a key risk for the non-life insurance sector.
